flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/{CreateNoticeController (repccsWebhook-create-notice, ehtsftp-create-notice, cesWebhook-create-notice), CreateNoticeServiceImpl, helpers/{RepWebHookPayloadValidator,NoticeProcessingHelper.setProcessingStagesForX}, dto/RepWebHookPayloadDto}, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsOffenceNoticeOwnerDriver (generic CRUD) and workflows/notice_management/ownerdriver (PLUS). ocmsadminprivateapi workflows/repccs/notice_creation (RepccsCreateNoticeController), agencies/mha/upload/helpers/MhaNricDataHelper, workflows/datahiveuenfin, cron-schedules-prod.properties. thirdpartyapi cesTpApiARelay (CesCreateNoticeController, CesWebHookPayloadDto). ocmsadminui App.tsx, utils/data/LinkData.tsx, pages/Notice/form/NoticeUForm. ocmseserviceapi and ocmseserviceui: not relevant
note: Story status 'Requirement given - Gen flow': the requirement is only the story text; there is no flow deck and Appendix B of Annex 1A is not in the repo. The story asks OCMS to receive and update the offender's particulars from REPCCS/EHT so that UPL notices are followed up through the automated workflow. What exists: UPL notices (unidentified vehicle, plate 'N.A') are received from REPCCS and EHT/CES and created as type X, stage NPA, next stage DN1 with payment blocked. What does not exist: the REPCCS and EHT/CES payloads carry no offender name, NRIC/UEN or address (RepWebHookPayloadDto.java:20-101, CesWebHookPayloadDto.java:21-95), and notice creation writes no owner/driver row for this path, so 'receive the offender's particulars from REPCCS/EHT' is not done by the code. Particulars can only be updated through generic mechanisms (owner/driver CRUD, PLUS, a staff form whose route is commented out). One thing to watch: a UPL notice is given next stage DN1 with next date now, and the MHA upload job, which is enabled in prod, selects stage DN1 with no officer-decision gate, but only for offenders with ID type N. The DataHive UEN/FIN job is off in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false). Tickets: OCMS-SR-2026-101 and OCMS-DF-2026-102 (UPL payment defaults, Closed/Prod deployed; the code is now correct), OCMS-SR-2026-189 (UPL data patch, Closed) and OCMS-SR-2026-193 (UPL data patch, Ready to UAT, root cause written as 'UPL processing logic has not been implemented in OCMS'). REPCCS/EHT API contract, APIM and the real server property values: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim only the receipt of UPL notices from REPCCS/EHT. Receiving the offender's particulars from REPCCS/EHT does not exist; ask URA to confirm whether REPCCS/EHT really send particulars (the API spec is not in the repo) or whether staff/MHA/DataHive fill them, and for Appendix B of Annex 1A as the reference for the automated workflow

steps.step: REPCCS/EHT sends a UPL notice (unidentified vehicle) to OCMS
steps.detail: Three entry points in ocmsadminapi receive the transaction: POST /repccsWebhook-create-notice (CreateNoticeController.java:46), /ehtsftp-create-notice (:97) and /cesWebhook-create-notice (:103). ocmsadminprivateapi has /repccsWebhook (RepccsCreateNoticeController.java:39) and thirdpartyapi relays EHT/CES through /cesWebhook-create-notice (CesCreateNoticeController.java:22). An unidentified vehicle is recognised from VehicleCategory=0, VehicleRegistration=X, LicencePlate='N.A' (RepWebHookPayloadValidator.java:119-124; thirdpartyapi PayloadLengthValidator.java:84-87). This step is only about receiving the notice; the offender's particulars are covered in step 3. APIM/subscription key authentication and the REPCCS/EHT API contract: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The UPL notice enters the automated processing workflow (next stage is scheduled)
steps.detail: A blank/'N.A' vehicle number becomes type X (UPL) (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1015-1018, 1146-1147), then setProcessingStagesForX sets last stage NPA, next stage DN1, next date = now, payment_acceptance_allowed=N, composition_amount=0 and eservice_message_code=E4 (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:390-411). These payment defaults were once wrong (OCMS-SR-2026-101, OCMS-DF-2026-102, Closed/Prod deployed); the code is now correct, but UPL data patches keep being requested (OCMS-SR-2026-189 Closed, OCMS-SR-2026-193 Ready to UAT with root cause 'UPL processing logic has not been implemented in OCMS'). Automated jobs pick notices from next stage DN1 with no officer-decision gate (MhaNricDataHelper.java:183-192). Appendix B of Annex 1A is not in the repo, so conformity with the intended workflow order: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS receives the offender's particulars (name, NRIC/UEN, address) from REPCCS/EHT
steps.detail: The REPCCS payload (RepWebHookPayloadDto.java:20-101) and the EHT/CES payload (CesWebHookPayloadDto.java:21-95) only carry transaction data: car park, times, charge, violation code, vehicle, remarks, image/video. There is no offender name, NRIC/UEN or address field, and OffenceNoticeDto (OffenceNoticeDto.java:24-110) has none either. Notice creation writes no owner/driver row for the REPCCS/EHT path; the only owner insert in this flow is for military vehicles (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:723-727). So the offender of a UPL notice does not come from REPCCS/EHT. If URA sends particulars outside this payload, that spec (demo_remark: 'same specs as REP doc') cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: OCMS updates the offender's particulars on the UPL notice
steps.detail: A generic update mechanism exists: owner/driver CRUD (POST /offencenoticeownerdriver and /offencenoticeownerdriverpatch/{id1}/{id2}, OcmsOffenceNoticeOwnerDriverController.java:50,97) and PLUS /plus-update-offence-notice-owner-driver (OwnerDriverControllerPlus.java:39). A staff form for UPL notices with company UEN and person ID fields exists (NoticeUForm.tsx:226,396,409), but the create route for type U is commented out (App.tsx:130) and the Create Notice menu only goes to type O (LinkData.tsx:42). So an update exists as a general mechanism, not as receipt from REPCCS/EHT as the story says; a generic mechanism is not what the story names, hence Sebagian.

steps.step: Automated follow-up on the UPL notice once the offender's particulars exist (MHA/DataHive)
steps.detail: The MHA NRIC upload job is enabled in prod (cron.mhaupload.enabled=true, cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106) and selects next stage RD1/RD2/RR3/DN1/DN2/DR3 (MhaNricDataHelper.java:183-192), but only for owner/driver rows with offenderIndicator=Y and idType N (MhaNricDataHelper.java:345-346): a UPL notice with no offender row is not picked up and a UEN offender is not processed by MHA. The DataHive UEN/FIN job includes DN1 and id_type F/B (DataHiveUenFinService.java:235-246) but is switched off in prod: cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52). The real server property value: cannot verify from repo. DN1 letter generation through the cron does not run either (executeJob in ToppanUploadJobsScheduler is commented out, fact verified in the addendum), only the manual trigger.
